findings.title: Title-field rename leaves the sidebar row's accessible name (aria-label) stale while its visible label updates
findings.repro: 1) Select a document in the sidebar. 2) Rename it by editing the top 'Document name' field (type new name, Enter). 3) Inspect the sidebar row: textContent shows the new name but aria-label keeps the OLD name until a full sidebar re-render (switch file/collection, search, reload).
findings.expected: aria-label matches the visible row label after rename.
findings.observed: textContent='Renamed-Via-Title', aria-label='Untitled 3' (verified twice via eval; accessibility snapshots kept listing the old name).
findings.control: Row-menu Rename… route on the same document updates BOTH textContent and aria-label immediately — same app, different route, proving the title-field path misses the attribute update.
findings.sourceMechanism: app-js.txt: final override `refreshSidebarDocument=function(f){if(sbQuery||starsOnly)return renderSidebar();const row=[...sbList.querySelectorAll('[data-document-id]')].find(...);if(!row)return;row.querySelector('.n').textContent=f.name}` updates only the .n label; the earlier `function refreshSidebarDocument(f){...;row.querySelector('.n').textContent=f.name||'Untitled';row.setAttribute('aria-label',f.name||'Untitled')}` (which updates aria-label) is replaced by this later assignment. Reached via titleInput input handler -> debounced Store.save -> persistWorkspace chain `if(changed)refreshSidebarDocument(doc)`.
findings.impact: Screen-reader users and accessibility-tree consumers hear/see the old document name indefinitely; automation snapshots misidentify the row. Fix: add row.setAttribute('aria-label',f.name||'Untitled') to the final refreshSidebarDocument.

findings.title: B280 extension: renaming via the top title field also leaves {title} page-footer/header placeholders stale (known trigger was sidebar Rename)
findings.classification: CONFIRMED (extension of B280 — materially new trigger route)
findings.repro: 1) Insert > Header & footer, set Footer to 'FOOTER-T:{title}', Apply (footer renders with current name). 2) Rename the document via the top 'Document name' field. 3) Footer still shows the OLD name.
findings.expected: Footer {title} placeholder reflects the current document name.
findings.observed: footer='FOOTER-T:Untitled 3' while doc.name='Renamed-Via-Title'; refreshed to the new name only after a content re-render (control: an editor undo/typing triggers renderFromMd->syncWriterPage).
findings.control: same document, re-render control after rename (footer became fresh); row-menu rename shows the same staleness (original B280 trigger, rediscovered).
findings.sourceMechanism: syncWriterPage() (footer.textContent=...replace(/\{title\}/g,doc.name)) is only invoked from renderFromMd wrapper and setWriter; no rename path calls it (app-js.txt).
findings.impact: Printed/exported-looking page chrome shows a stale title until arbitrary later re-render. Fix: call syncWriterPage() (or re-render page chrome) on document rename.
